ref_text: It had been raining for three days. The kind of rain that doesn't wash anything clean. I lit a cigarette, watched the neon bleed into the gutter, and waited for a phone that wasn't going to ring.

voices.instruct: A man in his mid forties with a very deep, gravelly bass-baritone: a smoker's rasp, rough and worn at the edges. American English. Slow, heavy and unhurried, quiet, like a detective narrating at three in the morning. Never theatrical.

A man of forty-five with a deep, hoarse, raspy voice, damaged by years of cigarettes and whisky, with vocal fry at the ends of his sentences. American English. Slow and flat, tired, close to the microphone.
A man in his forties with a very deep, dark, smooth bass voice and almost no rasp. American English. Calm, slow, controlled and quiet, with weight behind every word.
A man near fifty with a low, cracked, weary voice, the voice of someone who hasn't slept, with a little breath in it. American English. Slow, resigned, intimate.
A man in his forties with a deep, hard, clipped voice: a former policeman, used to being obeyed. American English. Low and quiet, cold, economical and slow, with gravel underneath.
A man in his forties speaking in a very low, husky near-whisper, deep and breathy with a rough edge. American English. Slow film-noir narration, close to the microphone.
A Japanese man in his mid forties speaking fluent English with a light Japanese accent. A very deep, gravelly, smoke-roughened voice, slow and weary. Quiet, close to the microphone, understated.

groups.title: Emotion
groups.note: One line, said differently. Fish takes a description in brackets. Chatterbox has no named emotions, only how much feeling (its 'exaggeration' setting), so its rows are that setting at three strengths.

items.label: as written
items.all: You shouldn't have come here. Not tonight.

items.label: weary
items.fish: [tired, flat, worn out] You shouldn't have come here. [sigh] Not tonight.

items.label: cold threat
items.fish: [quiet, cold, threatening] You shouldn't have come here. [pause] Not tonight.

items.label: angry
items.fish: [angry, raising his voice] You shouldn't have come here! Not tonight!

items.label: dry amusement
items.fish: [amused, dry] [chuckles] You shouldn't have come here. Not tonight.

items.label: grief
items.fish: [grieving, voice breaking, close to tears] You shouldn't have come here. [shaky breath] Not tonight.

items.label: hurt, wounded
items.fish: [in pain, through gritted teeth, short of breath] You shouldn't have come here. [groans] Not tonight.

items.label: drunk
items.fish: [drunk, slurring] You shouldn't have come here. [hiccup] Not tonight.

items.label: whispered
items.fish: [whispering urgently] You shouldn't have come here. Not tonight.

chatterbox.t: You shouldn't have come here. Not tonight.
You shouldn't have come here. Not tonight.
You shouldn't have come here. Not tonight.

groups.title: Sighs, grunts, groans and the rest
groups.note: Sounds that aren't words. Fish takes any description in brackets; Chatterbox-Turbo knows a fixed set ([sigh] [groan] [gasp] [cough] [chuckle] [laugh] [clear throat] [sniff]); plain Chatterbox has none.

items.label: sigh
items.fish: [sighs heavily] Monday again.

items.label: a drag on a cigarette
items.fish: [inhales, then exhales slowly] She said her husband was missing.

items.label: chuckle
items.fish: [low chuckle] You really thought that would work?
items.turbo: [chuckle] You really thought that would work?

items.label: cough
items.fish: [coughs] These things will kill me. [pause] Something has to.
items.turbo: [cough] These things will kill me. Something has to.

items.label: clears his throat
items.fish: [clears throat] Kirishima Investigations.

items.label: grunt of effort
items.fish: [grunts with effort] Get up. [panting] We're not done.

items.label: taking a punch
items.fish: [grunts as if punched in the stomach] [coughing] Is that all you've got?

items.label: groan of pain
items.fish: [groans in pain] It's nothing. [sharp intake of breath] Just a scratch.

items.label: a low moan, coming round
items.fish: [low moan, waking up in pain] [heavy breathing] Where am I?

items.label: sounds only, no words
items.fish: [grunt] [heavy panting] [groan of pain]

items.label: a bitter laugh
items.fish: [bitter laugh] Sure. Justice.
